'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**Three [[Armenia]]n police officers and two [[Azerbaijani soldier]]s are killed during [[Armenia–Azerbaijan border|border]] clashes near the [[Lachin Corridor]]. Both countries accuse the other of opening fire first. [https://www.dw.com/en/armenian-and-azerbaijani-border-clash-leaves-five-dead/a-64891575 (DW)]
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**[[Jihadist]] group [[al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula]] acknowledges that a senior leader was killed in a recent [[airstrike]] by the [[United States Air Force]] in [[Yemen]]. [https://www.wionews.com/world/al-qaeda-says-top-leader-killed-in-strike-in-yemen-568947 (WION)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Kutupalong refugee camp fire]]
**More than 2,000 shelters are destroyed in a fire in [[Kutupalong refugee camp]], [[Ukhia]], [[Cox's Bazar]], [[Chittagong Division]], [[Bangladesh]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-64858932 (BBC)]
*Two people are killed and nine others are injured in a human [[stampede]] at a [[GloRilla]] concert in [[Rochester, New York|Rochester]], [[New York (state)|New York]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/rochester-glorilla-concert-stampede-finesse2tymes-bed449a961333fa69081b686cb39f7f3 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Estonian parliamentary election]]
**[[Estonians]] head to [[polling place|the polls]] to elect the 101 members of the [[Riigikogu]]. [https://apnews.com/article/estonia-election-kallas-helme-b3dc215a53a822d7b82e5bf6020e4a52 (AP)]
